name: Society C | Smackerz
description: Smackerz is an indica dominant hybrid strain (70% indica/30% sativa) created through crossing the classic Gorilla Glue #4 X Rozay strains. Smackerz packs a super delicious flavor and soothing sleepy high. Smackerz has a sweet fruity flavor that's accented by touches of spicy herbs and grassy funk. The aroma is very similar, with an earthy woody overtone accented by sweet lemongrass and spicy herbs.
